summary: # Azure Region Names Reference The Azure Retail Prices API requires `armRegionName` values in lowercase with no spaces. Use this table to map common region names to their API values. ## Region Mapping | Display Name | armRegionName | |-------------|---------------| | East US | `eastus` | | East US 2 | `eastus2` | | Central US | `centralus` | | North Central US | `northcentralus` | | South Central US | `southcentralus` |
